items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he was rehearsing with Barefield's band also... when we run in to him in New York... he would say, 'I'm Chief back here'

ctx.x: Well, in later years, he went -- no, we called him Papoose out here, that's what it was; that's what the story is -- he was Indian and he was rehearsing with Barefield's band also, and in later years when we saw him back east -- he went back east and started to play with all the bands, but out here we called him Papoose, and so when we run in to him in New York, the first time you'd see him, you'd say, 'Hey Papoose!' and he would say, 'I'm Chief back here, they call me Chief, they don't call me Papoose!'
So we used to rehearse at the Union ... no, this wasn't the Union. It was right across from Jefferson High School when Covan had his dancing school? Jefferson High
